rules: Fields both scorers agree on are adopted unchanged.
The first run's written rules apply: margins judged at normal viewing size; halo, title, rock and corner glyphs count as lettering, conservatively.
Watercolor soft edges are recorded but do not make an image flawed (ADR 0006 amendment 2); a painted frame still does.
Unrequested, prominent figures count as extra figures, as in the first run.
noFormFigure no/na disputes resolve to no; neither is a figure.

scores.notes: Operator (overall disputed): Walls fall and horns blow; the crowd walks out through the breach rather than into the city, the same direction slip judged acceptable in the rerun (borderline). A: Wall breach between two standing towers, three priests blowing trumpets at left, Joshua with sword at right; edges fully painted, lintels, shields and sash hems carry no lettering. But the central column and the right-hand families face and walk toward the viewer out of the city streets through the breach, so the people read as leaving Jericho in a calm procession rather than going up into the city. B: Collapsed wall between two standing towers, three linen-robed priests blowing trumpets at left, Joshua-like leader pointing at right, families and spearmen at the breach; no lettering found on wall, shields or sashes and paint reaches all four edges. The crowd faces and walks toward the viewer out of the breach rather than into the city as the verse and composition ask, a direction mismatch a careful reader could notice.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Ezekiel in worn tunic and brown cloak stands left of center, seen from the side, right arm raised and pointing over a valley floor strewn with skulls and skeletons, dry riverbed and hills behind; God appears in no form. Painting reaches all four edges; the wooden tablet in his belt pouch is blank and no corner marks.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The Shulammite stands centred among pink roses and white lilies, with a shepherd's crook leaning against a stone wall at left, blossoming orchard trees at right and terraced hills behind. Painting reaches all four edges; no lettering in corners or elsewhere.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Wide green valley with river and lake basins under a golden, cloud-filled sky; zoomed clouds show no face or figure, and all four edges and corners are painted with no signature. Two small rustic huts (left hillside at ~x80,y490 and right at ~x1200,y580) are the only structures; no people or city.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Barefoot child at center holds cords leading to the wolf (left) and the reclining leopard (right), with lion cub, lamb, young goat beside the leopard, and calf, plus a staff lying in the grass; terraced olive hills and Jerusalem walls at upper right. All edges painted through, no lettering found in corners or on buildings.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The father runs with open arms through dust in the right-centre toward the ragged son, who is in the left foreground, with villagers watching at left and right. The son walks toward the viewer, away from the father, glancing sideways, so he is not coming to his father, and the farmhouse courtyard is missing. Painting is full to all edges; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Elderly Naomi seated on a bench at centre with a walking stick, six women of Bethlehem seated on mats and one standing at left, mud-brick house with lit doorway, clay jar and town walls at upper right. Edges fully painted; wall cracks, window bars and corners show no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Fiery streaks fall diagonally from dark smoke clouds onto the walled mud-brick city at center, with distant Gomorrah burning at left, palm gardens and small figures walking away on the road at lower right; smoke and clouds contain no face or figure for God. All four edges painted, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Jesus stands in the bow (centre-right) with his arm outstretched over now-calm water, while disciples in the foreground look up at him. A furled sail, ropes and an oil lamp are present; a disciple at right holds an anachronistic metal-and-glass hurricane lantern. No storm cloud or night remains. Painting is full to the edges; the striped cloth at bottom right is a pattern, not text.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Strong match: Peter steps off the gunwale with arms out, one bare foot on the water, Jesus standing on the waves mid-distance, disciples at the rail with a lantern, starry night sky; no lettering. However a small flat teal square (~16px, at x~1344-1360, y0-15) sits on the top edge near the top-right corner, a non-painted digital artifact a reader can spot against the dark sky; otherwise acceptable.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Peter, grinning and clutching a brown coat to his chest, leaps from the bow of the boat at center while the beloved disciple behind him points left to Jesus standing on the shore beside a small charcoal fire; a net of fish trails at lower right. The boat holds nine disciples in all against John's seven, a minor count slip; all edges painted, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Bald Elisha in a fur-collared mantle stands in the right foreground, while a band of youths streams down the dusty road from the Bethel gate (upper left), cupping their mouths and pointing. A pillar idol and an altar stand on the hill above. Painting is full to all edges; no lettering.

Operator (edges disputed): A solid red-brown band runs the full height of both side edges: a painted border band. A: Abstract cream band of light sweeps down from the top edge over misty dark water with ripples at centre; zoomed light shows no face or figure and no lettering. But a solid reddish-brown border stripe (~15px) runs the full height of both the left and right edges, a painted border band. B: A plain red-brown band about 15-20px wide runs the full height of both the left and right edges, like exposed ground or a thin frame, so the painting does not reach those borders. The light itself is a formless sweeping stream from the top edge over misty dark water with ripples, no face or figure in it.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Goliath stumbles forward in the foreground with his forehead covered by an undamaged helmet and no stone strike, while a sling stone lies on the ground beside David's feet at center, so the stone never reaches its target; Goliath's left hand also grips a spear and a drawn sword together while another sword hangs at his hip. Edges are fully painted and the shields carry no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: At top centre a beam of white light falls on an empty flaming throne, surrounded by burning thrones and wheels in the clouds. Zoomed in, there is no face, body or robe in the light. Elderly Daniel stands at right gazing up, and walled Babylon with ziggurats is at lower left. Full edges; no lettering on the walls or elsewhere.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Job in undyed tunic and indigo cloak sits on an ash heap with a crook, head lifted; a dust whirlwind rises at left-centre, a bright glow breaks through clouds at top centre with no face or figure in it, walled city with rain at right. Edges fully painted, no lettering; no visible fire and Job's cloak is not wind-blown, minor.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Six exiles sit with bowed heads on the grassy bank at lower left, with two lyres and travel bundles on the grass and a river with willows leading to Babylon's brick walls and towers at right under dusk light. The lyres are still strung, a minor departure; all four edges painted, and the gate and corner scraps carry no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: At top centre, inside the radiance on the flaming throne, a white robed figure sits with a visible bearded face and hands resting on the armrests: the Ancient of Days is shown in human form. Daniel is at right, with burning wheels and Babylon below; painting is full to the edges; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Closed, blank scroll with wooden rollers rests on a stone ledge at the base of an arched niche in a plastered building at centre, arched synagogue door to its right; villagers and donkeys small at left and right on a stone street. Zoomed scroll, wall cracks and all four edges show no lettering and the paint reaches every border.

Operator (noFormFigure disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: David in a blue robe reclines on the grass among resting and grazing sheep beside a winding stream, with a lyre, staff, sling and dagger at lower left and a terraced village behind. A painted signature reading like 'C. ...' sits in the grass at the extreme bottom-right corner under the lying sheep. B: David reclines on the grass in the lower middle among resting and grazing sheep, with a curving stream at right, terraces and a village behind, and staff, sling, harp and sword on the grass; the Shepherd of the verse appears as no figure. A cursive painter's signature is painted in the grass at the extreme bottom-right corner.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Three kneeling Roman soldiers cast dice over garments and sandals on the ground (centre-bottom), but Jesus on the cross (upper centre-right) is still fully dressed in a white tunic and a blue mantle, which contradicts his clothing being divided. He is also prominent rather than veiled by distance. Painting is full to the edges; there is no titulus or other lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Empty throne in radiant cloud under a rainbow, flanked by four winged creatures (lion, ox, man, eagle) with eyes on their wings, over a crystal-tiled floor; no form on or around the throne and edges are fully painted. But the unrequested golden chest at centre (~x600-780, y480-580) has a faint row of looping cursive-like scrawl across its front panel that reads as an inscription.

Operator (coherence disputed): A seraph holds the coal from verse 6 and the seraphim's faces and feet are uncovered; flawed by both scorers. A: The two seraphim at top are robed human angels with bare, uncovered faces and feet and about four or five wings each, none veiling face or feet, and the left one already holds tongs with a glowing coal (the verse 6 action) while the right one prays. The radiant cloud at top center holds no face or figure for God; all edges are painted and the gold wall reliefs carry no lettering. B: The two seraphim (upper left and right) are robed angels with four wings each, with faces and bare feet uncovered, and the left one already holds tongs with a burning coal from verse 6, contradicting the six wings covering face and feet that the verse describes. Isaiah stands gazing up in the lower center of a gold-carved temple with priests at both side doorways; the radiant cloud at top center holds no figure, edges full, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Paul stands left of centre with one hand on a stone wall and his face lifted, with terraced olive hillside behind. Villagers carry water jars, a donkey is tethered by a doorway, and two cloaked soldiers stand at the distant city gate (right). The scroll in his belt is blank; painting is full to all edges with no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Moses with staff leads a long column of Israelites with bundles, children, sheep and a goat along the wet seabed between curling green walls of water left and right; the pillar is a vertical fiery glow in the dawn sky at top centre with no human shape. Edges painted to the border (only a 1-2px darker sliver at the top-left), no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A faint translucent robed human figure with head, shoulders and outstretched arms hovers in the pale sky at top center-right above the altar, a form standing for God. Abraham raises the knife over Isaac, who lies unbound under a blanket on the wood like a resting adult; edges are painted through and there is no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Abraham raises a knife over Isaac on the wood-topped altar, while God is shown only as a soft glowing cloud at top centre (no figure in it). The knife appears three times: raised in his hand, stuck by Isaac's head on the altar, and lying on the ground at bottom centre. Isaac, an adult, lies unbound with hands folded. Full edges; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Moses (left-centre) with staff and right hand raised beside Aaron in an ornate ephod and stone breastplate, families seated at right, tents and the tabernacle behind with a white cloud column rising from it and no shape in the cloud; a pig stands at lower left beside the food table and a second small pig mid-ground. Ephod bands are geometric weave, no lettering; all edges painted. Minor: Aaron is not in plain linen and the pig is not visibly set apart from clean animals.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: A white-bearded old man lies with eyes closed and hands folded on a straw-and-rug bed in the grass at lower center, a shepherd's staff beside him, while nine mourners kneel or stand with bowed heads; tents, mud-brick houses and a small round stone structure sit in open land behind. All four edges are painted and no corner marks.

Operator (noFormFigure disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: Jonah sits alone, curled with arms around his knees, on a fleshy mound inside a ribbed organic cavity with dark pools of water. A pale opening of light at top centre contains no figure. Dark painting reaches all four edges; no lettering. B: Jonah sits alone, hugging his knees on a fleshy mound inside a ribbed, wet fish cavity, with dark pools at the bottom and pale light coming through an opening at top centre; God appears only as that light, with no face or form in it (zoomed). The corners darken into painted shadow rather than blank paper, and there is no lettering.

Operator (noFormFigure, matchesScene disputed): noFormFigure no/na: no figure either way; matchesScene takes the lower label. A: Daniel stands calm at centre of a stone den among four lions with closed mouths, Darius in purple robes leans on the rim at upper right, wooden lid tilted aside at upper left; edges painted, no lettering. But at top centre (~x660-720, y0-25) the pale light holds the cut-off lower half of a robed figure, a teal robe hem with two dangling bare feet cropped by the top edge, an angel figure instead of the requested suggested light. B: Daniel stands calm at the centre of a stone pit with four closed-mouthed lions lying around him, the wooden lid pushed aside on the rim at upper left and Darius in a purple robe with a ring leaning over the rim at upper right. At the very top edge (centre, x about 670-710) the pale radiance contains the lower part of a hovering figure, a teal robe hem with pinkish dangling legs cut off by the border; it reads as the angel rather than God, but the scene asked only for suggested light and the cropped legs look odd.

Operator (matchesScene, overall disputed): Walls of water stand either side of the channel with Moses's staff raised; the loose geography and calm Egyptian onlookers are minor (borderline). A: Moses with staff stands at left, arm stretched out, under a stormy night sky with no face or figure in the bright cloud; a tall wave rises at far left behind him and a long water wall at right, but the channel's left side is rocky land with a walled hilltop city and the floor carries a stream of water, so the divided sea reads only loosely. Five Egyptians in linen stand calmly at mid-right as onlookers right beside the Israelites rather than in the distance; edges are painted through and there is no lettering. B: Moses stands in the left foreground with staff and arm outstretched as towering walls of water stand at far left and right around a wet channel, Israelites gather on the rocks, and a small group at right includes one Egyptian in a white kilt; the moonlit storm clouds at top center hold no figure. The geography is loose (the left water wall rises behind the people, with a walled town on the cliffs beside the channel) and the Egyptian stands close rather than distant, but edges are full and there is no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: The grim Levite stands centre with a knife in his right hand and a staff in his left, beside the concubine's still body on a stone bench in the foreground, restrained and not gory. A lamp burns at left and a donkey and the night hill town show through the doorway. Full edges; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Saul stands at centre in a vertical column of light with no form in it, one hand raised, his staff dropped at his feet; four companions shield their eyes, crouch or stagger back on a stony road, with walled Damascus on the horizon. All edges painted, no lettering; minor: minaret-like towers and a dome in the city skyline.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: Jesus in a dark blue mantle stands right of center, right arm raised and mouth open in a call, while Lazarus in grave-cloths with bound legs steps from the dark rock-cut tomb at center, its round stone rolled aside at left; Martha and the crowd, some shading their eyes, flank both sides. Jesus faces outward and up rather than toward the cave, a minor departure; edges are painted through and there is no lettering, only a small red flower at the upper-left edge.

Both independent scorers agree on every scored field. A: David reclines on the grass among grazing and resting sheep beside a still stream, with terraces and a village behind and a lyre, staff, sling and sword beside him. A cursive signature-like scribble is painted in the grass in the bottom-right corner. Painting is otherwise full to the edges.
